sn13.6:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāpathavī parikkhāyaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ṭhapetvā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā || ||
sn13.6:1.4: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || yaṃ vā mahāpathaviyā parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ yā vā satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhāti || || 3
sn13.6:2.1: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ mahāpathaviyā yad idam parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ ||
sn13.6:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalam upenti na sahassimaṃ kalam upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalam upenti mahāpathaviyā parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇam upanidhāya satta kolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā avasiṭṭhā ti || || 4
